newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT to pursue independent int'l business strategy.
newsitem.headline: NTT to pursue independent int'l business strategy.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp hopes to pursue an independent approach to gain customers in the international market rather than seek tie-ups with international rivals, a Japanese newspaper quoted NTT's president as saying.

In the international market, telecommunications operators which can offer services useful to individual customers and know-how to cope with standardised connection equipment can win customers, NTT president Junichiro Miyazu said in an interview with the Nihon Keizai Shimbun published on Monday.
"NTT has a great deal of such know-how," Miyazu said.
"Rather than seeking tie-ups (with international telecommunications giants), NTT hopes to formulate and propose its own way of doing business in the international market," Miyazu said.
A NTT spokesman declined to elaborate on the interview but said NTT would pursue its own international business strategy.

NTT so far has been prohibited from offering international services. But the company is expected to announce its international business plans in early January, following an agreement with the government last month on a revised corporate structure.
